chunks: Al-Husayn from Safwan from Hariz from Zurara from him (peace be upon him) said:
The woman in ihram may use all types of kohl, except the black kohl used for adornment.

key_terms.اَلْمَرْأَةُ اَلْمُحْرِمَةُ: The woman in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What kohl is a woman in ihram allowed to use?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from the chain of Zurara clarifies the distinction between general cosmetic use and specific adornment (*zina*) for women in *ihram*. While men are broadly prohibited from wearing black kohl for beauty, women are permitted to use all types except black kohl designated specifically for decorative purposes, reflecting the nuanced application of gender-specific rulings in Shia fiqh. This highlights the scholarly principle that prohibitions in *ihram* often target the intent of adornment rather than the mere application of substances.
